vibe_rationale: Long-running, community-rooted free beach sculpture show with fringe events and workshops, but broad family appeal rather than a subculture core.
fit_notes: Family skew on a free beachfront walk dilutes adult targeting, though the active coastal setting suits a wellness presence. Sun Bum, a sun-care brand, is already a partner, and the Balter Taproom satellite shows local lifestyle brands take part.
